claims.claim: The demo was about 7 minutes long and was a technical validation for Granite Payments.
claims.why: CRM shows 10:00 to 10:07 demo in Technical Validation stage; transcript runs about 7 minutes.

claims.claim: Ravi showed the card transaction stream at about 3,000 transactions per second in the sample.
claims.why: Ravi said about 3 thousand transactions a second.

claims.claim: Ravi showed the fraud features feeding the scoring model and the case export to the case tool.
claims.why: U007 states exactly this.

claims.claim: Per-card features such as spend velocity update in under 5 seconds.
claims.why: Ravi said features like spend velocity per card update in under 5 seconds.

claims.claim: Liam's analysts currently work with features that are an hour stale.
claims.why: Liam said features are an hour stale today.

claims.claim: Liam said the demo showed what his analysts need.
claims.why: Liam said 'That's what my analysts need.'

claims.claim: Events queue and catch up in order with nothing dropped when the stream backs up.
claims.why: Ravi stated this directly.

claims.claim: In a sandbox test, a 10-minute outage caught up in about 90 seconds.
claims.why: Ravi gave this sandbox figure.

claims.why: Helen said they don't pay annually up front, quarterly in arrears only.

claims.claim: Helen's engineering lead believes they can build this in six months.
claims.why: Helen said the engineering lead thinks they can build in six months.
